title: Offloading bounded decisions cut agent LLM calls by 29.6% on 360 SOP-Bench cases - Show and Tell - Hugging Face Forums

gate.text: If both yes probabilities reach 0.8, the harness advances without the follow-up LLM turn.

calls.text: Main-LLM calls fell from 2,537 to 1,785: 29.6% fewer.

cost.text: Estimated execution API cost, including Jev, fell from $6.41 to $4.70: 26.6% lower.

tradeoff.text: completion checking alone saved 23.8% of LLM calls but finished 356/360 tasks correctly
